messages:
Maya (CS): Quick pulse — putting together a short list of product-facing signals from onboarding & renewal checks. Goal: surface 2 high-impact fixes to ship in 6 weeks.
Jonah (CS): SummitHealth onboarding — customers asking for per-route visibility on token/cost breakout. They saw big variance and want exportable view. Renewal risk if we don't show it.
Priya (PM): Can you paste an example of what they'd export? CSV? screenshot? (cc @Leo)
Jonah (CS): Example snippet:
```
route,requests,tokens,cost_usd
chat:default,320,12800,12.8
embeddings:search,40,4000,4.0
```
Jonah (CS): They also asked for ability to filter by model version and date range.
Leo (SE): Short-term workaround: use /reports with model param + date. UX is clunky but doable. Long-term: per-route export + filters makes sense.
Maya (CS): Other signal: onboarding playbooks — new customers get confused by 'burst capacity' toggle in console. Several support tickets and a churn-y trial.
Priya (PM): Ok — sounds like two buckets: 1) observability exports/filters, 2) console clarity for onboarding toggles. Which should be higher priority by renewal-risk?
Maya (CS): I'd rank observability exports higher (directly tied to billing disputes + renewal). Console clarity next (reduces support volume).
Priya (PM): I can take observability exports. Quick ask: scope — export endpoint + model/version + date + per-route breakdown. ETA target? 6 weeks realistic?
Maya (CS): 6 weeks is fine. Can we aim MVP that supports CSV export and a simple filter bar?
Priya (PM): Yes. I'll open a ticket and add acceptance criteria.
feedback-bot: :white_check_mark: Created backlog item INF-736 — "Per-route observability export + filters" assigned to Priya. Priority: P1.
Maya (CS): Jonah — can you collect 2 customer examples (screen grab or CSV) and drop them in the ticket? That'll help scoping.
Jonah (CS): On it. Will upload snippets by EOD.
Priya (PM): Leo — can you advise on expected perf/cost for generating CSV for large orgs? If heavy, we'll add sampling/async export.
Leo (SE): I'll run a quick estimate tomorrow. If >5M tokens/day for org, we should queue exports.
Maya (CS): OK — last bit: scheduling 15-min sync with product + cs to handoff examples and decide rollout approach. Friday 10am PT works?
Priya (PM): Works for me.
Jonah (CS): Works.
Leo (SE): Works.
Maya (CS): Thanks all — closing the loop here. I'll post ticket link once Jonah uploads examples.
